This is a Tinker addon that adds unique tinker tools and materials.

New tools:

Tinker's Medal: made with 2 parts. Equipped on a unique curios slot

Blowgun: made with 2 parts. Can shoot multiple times consecutively.

Meteor Spear: A five parts throwable melee weapon with higher attack damage and attack speed than normal throwing weapons.

New materials:

  • Black Gold
  • Flame Steel
  • Final Shell
  • Black Flash Alloy
  • Colored Glaze Star
  • Elf's Crystal
  • Plague Bone
  • Colorful Slime
  • Knight Crystal
  • Mithril
  • Black Dragon Substance

New liquid fuels:

- Dragon Breath: has higher fuel temperature than blaze blood
